log_evidence: Could not find PDB file / failed to load pdb info
impact: IDA attempted external symbol lookup. No production game or NESYS endpoint was contacted. No data was sent. The lookup targeted Microsoft symbol server only.
corrective_action: Subsequent IDA runs used process-local _NT_SYMBOL_PATH and _NT_ALT_SYMBOL_PATH pointing only at tools/ida_g21/symbols (empty local directory). No srv*, symsrv*, http://, https://, or UNC paths were used.
note: The initial IDA smoke test attempted an unintended Microsoft symbol-server lookup. Subsequent runs used process-local local-only symbol paths.
